name: The Great Emperor Ashoka
description: The story of Ashoka, emperor of the Maurya Empire, from his early struggles to his reign as a ruthless emperor.

videos.title: Acharya Chanakya's horrifying dream
videos.overview: This is the life journey of Ashoka the Great. It starts with Acharya Chanakya's dream where he sees Emperor Chandragupta in the form of a lion trying to warn him of a future disaster. While on the hunt, Mir Khorasan's son Aslan and King Bindusara are ambushed which leaves Aslan dead and King Bindusara fatally wounded.
